props.heading: Long-Term Cat Boarding
props.content:
LONG-TERM BOARDING

Life doesn’t always go as planned. Whether you’re relocating, traveling for an extended period, dealing with a family emergency, or undergoing home renovations, Cats Luv Us offers long-term boarding options that ensure your cat is safe, comfortable, and well-cared-for — for as long as they need to stay.

Our long-term boarding program is specifically designed for stays of two weeks or more, with significant savings compared to our nightly rates. We understand that extended stays require a different level of care and attention, and our protocols reflect that with enhanced enrichment schedules, regular health assessments, and more personalized daily routines.

Standard Suite (30 days): Starting at $750/month Luxury Suite (30 days): Starting at $1,100/month Second Cat (same suite): 25% discount on second cat 90+ Day Rate: Additional 10% discount available

Rates subject to change. Contact us for a personalized long-term quote.

Cats are creatures of routine, and extended stays can be a significant adjustment. That’s why our long-term boarding program includes a detailed intake interview where we learn about your cat’s daily habits, food preferences, play style, sleeping patterns, and any behavioral quirks. We use this information to create a customized daily schedule that mirrors your cat’s routine at home as closely as possible.

Our cat care specialists also monitor for signs of stress or behavioral changes throughout the stay. If we notice anything concerning, we’ll contact you and, if necessary, consult with your veterinarian to ensure your cat remains healthy and happy.

We encourage pet parents to visit their cats during long-term stays. You’re welcome to schedule visitation times during our regular hours. For cat parents who are traveling or unable to visit, we provide regular photo and video updates so you can see your cat thriving in our care.

Ready to discuss a long-term boarding plan for your cat? Contact us today or call (949) 582-1732 to speak with a team member about rates and availability.
